definitions.gloss: to return; to give back; to hand back
definitions.explanation: To return something that was borrowed, rented, or temporarily in one's possession. More formal than {返|かえ}す.

examples.japanese: {本|ほん}を{返却|へんきゃく}する。
{図書館|としょかん}に{本|ほん}を{返却|へんきゃく}してください。
examples.english: Please return the book to the library.

examples.japanese: レンタカーは{営業所|えいぎょうしょ}に{返却|へんきゃく}しなければならない。
examples.english: The rental car must be returned to the office.

notes:
Compound of {返|へん} (return) + {却|きゃく} (reject, dismiss). More formal than {返|かえ}す. Commonly used in institutional contexts — libraries, rental services, and official procedures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {返却|へんきゃく}{期限|きげん}: return deadline
- {返却|へんきゃく}{日|び}: return date
- {返却|へんきゃく}ポスト: book return drop box
- {返却|へんきゃく}{手続|てつづ}き: return procedure

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {返|かえ}す: to return (everyday, casual)
- {返品|へんぴん}する: to return merchandise (specifically goods to a store)
- {返納|へんのう}する: to return to the authorities (licenses, official items — very formal)
